summary: New Richmond Regional Airport (RNH/KRNH) is a medium-sized general aviation facility serving New Richmond, Wisconsin, in the western part of the state near the Minnesota border. The airport supports corporate, recreational, and flight training operations, and is positioned within convenient reach of the Twin Cities metro area. It features a single main runway and serves as a key regional aviation hub for St. Croix County.
faqs:
Q: What type of airport is New Richmond Regional Airport?
A: It is a medium-sized general aviation airport that primarily serves private, corporate, and recreational flights, with no scheduled commercial airline service.

Q: Where is the airport located?
A: The airport is located in New Richmond, Wisconsin, in St. Croix County, approximately 40 miles northeast of Minneapolis-St. Paul.

Q: Are there car rentals available at the airport?
A: Rental car availability is limited; visitors typically arrange ground transportation in advance or use local rental agencies in New Richmond.

Q: Can pilots get fuel and services at RNH?
A: Yes, the airport offers fueling services and basic aircraft amenities for general aviation pilots.
transport_tips: The airport is located just a few miles east of downtown New Richmond, easily reachable by car via local roads. Visitors flying in from the Twin Cities can expect roughly a one-hour drive. Taxi and rideshare services may be limited, so arranging a rental car or having a local contact provide pickup is recommended.
local_tip: If you have time before or after your flight, visit the New Richmond Heritage Center to learn about the town's history, or grab a meal at one of the locally owned diners downtown—residents are known for being welcoming to visiting pilots and travelers.
